entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A session of the Grand National Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: A session of the Grand National Assembly was in order because of the continued discussion about the emergency. The opposition wanted to declare it null and void.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was seated in one of the seats re..."
entries.dialogueText: I was seated in one of the seats reserved for the council of ministers, which was positioned slightly higher than the rest of the seats and had an angle that made for a clear view of the whole place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I glanced down at the USP seats and..."
entries.dialogueText: I glanced down at the USP seats and casually watched the people inside as Gloria announced the next speaker before the vote to revoke the decree.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. Frens Ricter from the People's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Frens Ricter from the People's Freedom and Justice Party has the floor."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Ladies and Gentlemen! A devastatin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and Gentlemen! A devastating picture has often been painted of the state of affairs prevailing in Sordland today. As always in such cases, there is no lack of exaggeration."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Considering the extreme measures b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Considering the extreme measures being taken that completely sets aside our freedoms, no one can fairly demand or expect of us to accept this extension of the Emergency Act."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""The elections of December have res..."
entries.dialogueText: "The elections of December have resulted in a majority for the USP and thus given Mr. Rayne the opportunity to govern, strictly as laid down in the intention of the Constitution."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""But where this opportunity is give..."
entries.dialogueText: "But where this opportunity is given, it is coupled with obligations. Respecting the laws and listening to criticism is necessary."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Not only the Assembly's opinion wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only the Assembly's opinion was not asked, the reasons for the emergency nor its extension were not justified!"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""The President clearly has ideologi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The President clearly has ideological intentions. This decree was an attempt to destroy the Socialist Movement."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""This decree was a declaration of w..."
entries.dialogueText: "This decree was a declaration of war against the Bludish people. The President does not even shy away from using divisive words. He has political intentions which will have grave consequences for our country."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_Banned_YS == true

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Mr. Rayne is exploiting the shooti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Rayne is exploiting the shooting of Bernard Circas and using this to his advantage to give us all these lies about national security threats!"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Ladies and Gentlemen of the United..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and Gentlemen of the United Sordland Party! You have claimed to have reformed the party and promised to bring the change people have been asking for."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Yet while the workers, the peasant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yet while the workers, the peasants, the whitecollar employees, the civil servants, or the businessmen of Sordland have their own troubles and demands from us, you go about fighting wars with enemies that don't exist!"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Everybody expected of you to rewri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Everybody expected of you to rewrite the outdated Constitution of Tarquin Soll. Now we have an emergency on our hands, which is fabricated to create a justification for the lack of reforms of the government. And their apparent hunger for authority!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Loud applauses came from the opposi..."
entries.dialogueText: Loud applauses came from the opposition.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gestured at Gloria to ask for an..."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at Gloria to ask for an opportunity to respond to Frens Ricter.
entries.menuText: Ask Gloria for a moment to respond.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I kept watching Frens Ricter."
entries.dialogueText: I kept watching Frens Ricter.
entries.menuText: Stay silent.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I stood up."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up.
entries.menuText: Stand up and yell at him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I shouted at him in protest."
entries.dialogueText: I shouted at him in protest.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I ask for my honorable colleagues..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask for my honorable colleagues to support the PFJP in revoking this emergency, here and now!"

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""I'm sorry to interrupt, Mr. Ricter..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry to interrupt, Mr. Ricter, but the President has asked for an opportunity to respond. You have directly addressed the President in your speech, so I shall give him the opportunity to give a brief response."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria looked at me and nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria looked at me and nodded.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""The President has the floor.""
entries.dialogueText: "The President has the floor."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Ricter, you speak of pure slan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ricter, you speak of pure slander. There are no political intentions behind this decree. It is a national emergency!"
entries.menuText: "Mr. Ricter, you speak of pure slander. There are no political intentions..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Gentlemen, you're underestimating..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gentlemen, you're underestimating the threats!"
entries.menuText: "Gentlemen, you're underestimating the threats!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Ricter! Who are you to speak a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ricter! Who are you to speak about such things?"
entries.menuText: "Mr. Ricter! Who are you to speak about such things?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Frens laughed sarcastically."
entries.dialogueText: Frens laughed sarcastically.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will be controlling the situati..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be controlling the situation shortly. Be patient!"
entries.menuText: "We will be controlling the situation shortly. Be patient!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We know that Mr. Ricter himself ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know that Mr. Ricter himself has ties with foreign interests!"
entries.menuText: "We know that Mr. Ricter himself has ties with foreign interests!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The State is doing what's best for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The State is doing what's best for Sordland."
entries.menuText: "The State is doing what's best for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. President, let's keep it brief.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, let's keep it brief."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The decree is completely legal.""
entries.dialogueText: "The decree is completely legal."
entries.menuText: "The decree is completely legal."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't be fooled by Mr. Ricter's sl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be fooled by Mr. Ricter's slander. We all know the truth."
entries.menuText: "Don't be fooled by Mr. Ricter's slander. We all know the truth."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This emergency will show us the re..."
entries.dialogueText: "This emergency will show us the real traitors among us."
entries.menuText: "This emergency will show us the real traitors among us."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""I have to let Mr. Ricter continue,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to let Mr. Ricter continue, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. Frens Ricter has the floor.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Frens Ricter has the floor."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""PURE SLANDER!""
entries.dialogueText: "PURE SLANDER!"
entries.menuText: "PURE SLANDER!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""DON'T WASTE OUR TIME!""
entries.dialogueText: "DON'T WASTE OUR TIME!"
entries.menuText: "DON'T WASTE OUR TIME!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""WATCH WHAT YOU ARE SAYING!""
entries.dialogueText: "WATCH WHAT YOU ARE SAYING!"
entries.menuText: "WATCH WHAT YOU ARE SAYING!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""VERY CREATIVE!""
entries.dialogueText: "VERY CREATIVE!"
entries.menuText: "VERY CREATIVE!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Frens first looked at me and then a..."
entries.dialogueText: Frens first looked at me and then at Gloria.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Mr. President... Please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President... Please."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Please continue, Mr. Ricter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please continue, Mr. Ricter."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Thank you, Mrs. Speaker.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Thank you, Mrs. Speaker. I have to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker. I have to say, I deplore the reaction of the President..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He cleared his throat."
entries.dialogueText: He cleared his throat.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I am talking to the members of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am talking to the members of the United Sordland Party as well! Do not act partisan in matters with such critical importance. We know that this emergency is a dangerous exaggeration and it can have very grim consequences on our democratic institutions."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I wish to trust in your judgement..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish to trust in your judgement and ask for your help in reaching an absolute majority against this decree."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One man from the USP seats yelled:..."
entries.dialogueText: One man from the USP seats yelled: "in your dreams!" It made the USP burst in laughter.

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""When in fact the Assembly fails to..."
entries.dialogueText: "When in fact the Assembly fails to deliver its duties for the good of the Sordish people, I shall be personally making a case to the Supreme Court about the legality of this emergency."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Ladies and Gentlemen! We all know..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and Gentlemen! We all know that this emergency is unlawful!"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""It clearly breaches on the freedom..."
entries.dialogueText: "It clearly breaches on the freedoms and rights of men defined in the Section 100 of the Constitution."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""It breaches on the right for a fai..."
entries.dialogueText: "It breaches on the right for a fair trial by giving the State the right to detain anyone without a trial. This is a breach on democracy as well as the freedoms of men defined in the Section 100 of the Constitution."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: BaseGame.Reform_EmergencyDecree_SuspendedProtests == true

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Sordland is being practically tran..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland is being practically transformed into a police state."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""It also denies people's right to a..."
entries.dialogueText: "It also denies people's right to assemble in protest. This is a clear breach of freedom of expression and freedom of speech!"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""According to the Constitution, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Constitution, these rights can not be suspended under any other circumstances than being under invasion."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Do any of you see any Rumburgian t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do any of you see any Rumburgian tanks in Sordland? Are we under bombardment? There is nobody attacking but the State! They are persecuting thousands of innocents under national security threats! Who will stop the President from prosecuting all who oppose him tomorrow?"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""The State is acting illegally! I h..."
entries.dialogueText: "The State is acting illegally! I hereby invite the Supreme Court to duty and ask for them to subject this decree to a proper judicial review and revoke it before it's too late."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""I hail those who are persecuted an..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hail those who are persecuted and in despair. We hail the strong Sordish opposition. Their steadfastness and loyalty are worthy of acclaim. The courage of their convictions, their unbroken faith - are the guarantees of a brighter future."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""No decree can give you the power t..."
entries.dialogueText: "No decree can give you the power to destroy ideas which are eternal and indestructible!"

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""We must adhere to the basic princi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must adhere to the basic principles of a constitutional state, to the equality of rights, and the concept of social legislation anchored therein. I ask everybody's support in the upcoming vote."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mr. Ricter walked back to his seat..."
entries.dialogueText: Mr. Ricter walked back to his seat among applauses from his party.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Next, the Assembly will vote on PF..."
entries.dialogueText: "Next, the Assembly will vote on PFJP's demand to revoke the validity of the emergency."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""According to the Constitution, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Constitution, the Assembly requires at least two-thirds majority to revoke an emergency declared by the President."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""We have 131 ayes and 119 nays.""
entries.dialogueText: "We have 131 ayes and 119 nays."

entries.speaker: Frens Ricter
entries.title: Frens Ricter: ""Mr. President spoke nonsense.""
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President spoke nonsense."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "People started to get up from their..."
entries.dialogueText: People started to get up from their seats to take the envelopes and cast their votes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I kept sitting and did not go out t..."
entries.dialogueText: I kept sitting and did not go out to cast a vote.
entries.menuText: Keep sitting.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I stood up to join the voting."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up to join the voting.
entries.menuText: Go to cast a vote.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I grabbed the envelope and prepared..."
entries.dialogueText: I grabbed the envelope and prepared my vote.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I voted for it believing that it wo..."
entries.dialogueText: I voted for it believing that it would not succeed anyway.
entries.menuText: Vote aye for the fun of it.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I casted my vote against it."
entries.dialogueText: I casted my vote against it.
entries.menuText: Vote no.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I watched as everybody voted one by..."
entries.dialogueText: I watched as everybody voted one by one.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some time has passed when the votes..."
entries.dialogueText: Some time has passed when the votes were counted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly Gloria's gavel echoed in t..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly Gloria's gavel echoed in the hall, which eliminated the carefree attitude that lurked after the voting.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Ayes does not exceed the two-third..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ayes does not exceed the two-third threshold, so the nays have it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "PFJP members started making noises."
entries.dialogueText: PFJP members started making noises.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I asked to speak."
entries.dialogueText: I asked to speak.
entries.menuText: Ask to speak.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A lot of people including Frens Ric..."
entries.dialogueText: A lot of people including Frens Ricter demanded to speak.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Yes, Mr. Ricter.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. Ricter."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Frens looked directly at me."
entries.dialogueText: Frens looked directly at me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned around and went back to h..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned around and went back to his seat.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I stood up and walked towards the e..."
entries.dialogueText: I stood up and walked towards the exit.
entries.menuText: Leave the Assembly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The whole Assembly watched behind m..."
entries.dialogueText: The whole Assembly watched behind me as I walked.

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Yes, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I want to thank the members of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to thank the members of the Assembly for their support in the State's measures."
entries.menuText: "I want to thank the members of the Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let us try to be more civil toward..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let us try to be more civil towards each other in these difficult times."
entries.menuText: "Let us try to be more civil towards each other..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Ricter, you cannot stand again..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ricter, you cannot stand against the USP."
entries.menuText: "Mr. Ricter, you cannot stand against the USP."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Frens watched me with no emotions i..."
entries.dialogueText: Frens watched me with no emotions in his face.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I condemn Mr. Ricter's empathy and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I condemn Mr. Ricter's empathy and support for the prosecuted. They are prosecuted for their crimes."
entries.menuText: "I condemn Mr. Ricter's empathy and support for the prosecuted."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's put this behind us, we must..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's put this behind us, we must not deviate from the real enemy!"
entries.menuText: "Let's put this behind us, we must not deviate from the real enemy!"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Rest assured, we will handle all t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rest assured, we will handle all the problems."
entries.menuText: "Rest assured, we will handle all the problems."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Mansoun Leke interrupted me."
entries.dialogueText: Mansoun Leke interrupted me.

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""You talk about difficult times, en..."
entries.dialogueText: "You talk about difficult times, enemies and problems, yet all these are products of the Sordish State!"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""The Bludish people are refraining..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Bludish people are refraining themselves from turning against those who tortured and humiliated them for decades! We only ask to be properly represented in the Assembly. You say the decree has nothing to do with political agenda. But all we have are fingers being pointed out again."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Workers Party of Bludia is a compl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Workers Party of Bludia is a completely legal and democratic party that's being supported by millions of Bludish people! I condemn this State for silencing another democratic party again!"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""It seems Sordland has made its cho..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems Sordland has made its choice again. Any attempt to turn back the wheels of time will be in vain."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""We the Bludish people... and the d..."
entries.dialogueText: "We the Bludish people... and the democratic socialists are aware that one cannot eliminate the realities of power politics by the simple act of legal protests. We now see the reality of your present rule."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""But the people’s sense of justice..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the people’s sense of justice also wields political power, Mr. President! And we will never stop appealing to this sense of justice."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Order, Mr. Leke! Try to refrain fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Order, Mr. Leke! Try to refrain from speaking out of turn."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You have it all wrong, Mr. Leke.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have it all wrong, Mr. Leke."
entries.menuText: "You have it all wrong, Mr. Leke."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you implying violence against..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you implying violence against the State!?"
entries.menuText: "Are you implying violence against the State!?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This has nothing to do with race.""
entries.dialogueText: "This has nothing to do with race."
entries.menuText: "This has nothing to do with race."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you giving support to the sepa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you giving support to the separatists?"
entries.menuText: "Are you giving support to the separatists?"

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""We know how you rule, Mr. Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know how you rule, Mr. President! God save us all."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""Go ahead, create any reason to pro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Go ahead, create any reason to prosecute me too!"

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""Order! This issue has been settled.""
entries.dialogueText: "Order! This issue has been settled."

entries.speaker: Gloria Tory
entries.title: Gloria Tory: ""We will be moving on to the next t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be moving on to the next topic..."

entries.speaker: Mansoun Leke
entries.title: Mansoun Leke: ""The people’s sense of justice also..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people’s sense of justice also wields political power, Mr. President! And we will never stop appealing to this sense of justice!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I barely heard Mansoun Leke yelling..."
entries.dialogueText: I barely heard Mansoun Leke yelling behind me right when I walked out the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a tough session but the oppo..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a tough session but the opposition failed to revoke the emergency decree in the end, which worked perfectly for us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "However, Frens was going to disrupt..."
entries.dialogueText: However, Frens was going to disrupt the decree by going to the Court. If Orso's promise could be trusted, that would not create issues for us, but I still couldn't keep myself from worrying.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt back at ease as soon as I le..."
entries.dialogueText: I felt back at ease as soon as I left the Assembly's chaos behind.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The emergency was a hard decision..."
entries.dialogueText: "The emergency was a hard decision to make but it was needed."
entries.menuText: "The emergency was a hard decision to make but it was needed."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gloria did her best to bring order..."
entries.dialogueText: Gloria did her best to bring order back to the Assembly and proceed with the schedule.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After the session, I finally felt a..."
entries.dialogueText: After the session, I finally felt at ease when I left the chaos of the Assembly behind.
